Class Vision

java.lang.Object
org.firstinspires.ftc.teamcode.subsystems.Vision
All Implemented Interfaces:
dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
public class Vision extends Object implements dev.nextftc.core.subsystems.Subsystem
Vision subsystem tuned for the goBILDA Global Shutter USB Camera (3122-0004-0001). Native sensor aspect ratio is 16:10 (1280x800 or 640x400). Identifies any scorable AprilTagClusterDetection regardless of color or field location.
